prompts.spinner: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite sheet for Holy Diver NES HD pack at 2x scale. The reference is the ORIGINAL spinning enemy, not a finished render: a red living circular thorn-ring with a clearly OPEN EMPTY center and three broad curved ivory/steel scythe blades around its circumference. Create a polished dark Gothic SNES/GBA-style version with crimson ridged organic rim, dark burgundy depth, pale silver/ivory blades and restrained warm highlights. NO face or eyeball, no person, no solid center. Exactly THREE equal square animation cells in one horizontal row with generous transparent spacing: the SAME coherent ring shown rotated about its center at 0, 40 and 80 degrees. Three blades, same ring size, identical silhouette diameter, clean antialiased painterly pixel-art edges, bold readable shapes after reduction to 48x48 pixels each. Keep each creature entirely within its own cell. Transparent background, no scene, no shadows outside sprite, no labels or text.
prompts.insect: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent two-frame tiny flying insect sprite sheet for a dark Gothic SNES/GBA-quality game. The attached original NES enemy is the identity reference: a compact pale oval center with red/pink wings. Replace the prior bat interpretation with a clearly INSECT-like flying eye bug: compact rounded ivory eye/thorax with a small dark green pupil, short segmented dark abdomen, two tiny antennae and tucked fine insect legs. Wings are rounded translucent moth/fly membranes with pale rose veins, NOT bat wings, no fingers, no jagged leather, no ears. Exactly TWO equal square cells side by side, widely spaced on transparent background. First frame wings lifted diagonally up and outward, second wings beating sideways/down. Keep the body centered at the same scale in both frames. Wing silhouette stays fully inside each square. Bold simple eye and rounded wing shapes that remain legible reduced to 32x32 pixels; restrained detailed painted pixel-art shading, navy shadows, ivory center, muted coral wing edges. Front-facing symmetric body. No background, labels, borders, glow cloud or text.
prompts.bark: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: large seamless bark material for an ancient giant tree in a dark Gothic SNES/GBA game. Create an orthographic close view entirely filled with old oak bark. Broad irregular interlocking bark plates and sinuous vertical furrows, occasional subtle weathered knots and root-like twists. Dark charcoal umber in deep cracks, warm muted chestnut highlights on broad raised surfaces, sparse muted olive moss in crevices. Much larger, calmer forms than fine striped cedar bark: only about eight to ten broad ridges across the entire square. Painterly pixel-art quality, crisp coherent planes and restrained detail that will downsample beautifully. Balanced texture across all four edges so it tiles, no central hero composition. No perspective, no sky, no visible tree outline, no scenery, no straight plank lines, no fence, no repeated tiny vertical slats, no labels or text. Opaque square image.
